fact: The INS (Direction des Statistiques Sociales) published the Annuaire Statistique de l'Éducation 2024-2025 on 10 October 2025, 120 pages, on access, quality and financing of the education system; the page names no administrative source beyond education statistics and no earlier edition.
title: Annuaire Statistique de l'Éducation 2024-2025
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique (INS RDC)
